_metadata.description: Account, BYOK, and trusted metered inference obligations.

requirements.description: The account surface may connect the device-scoped subscription session or remain signed out without blocking local terminal use.
requirements.title: Optional Subscription Account

validation.notes: Account routes and the first settings tab are covered by API and UI targeted tests.

requirements.description: An OpenRouter BYOK value must be declaration-checked, stored by the credential authority, and absent from browser responses and storage.
requirements.title: Credential Authority BYOK

validation.notes: Credential handler tests prove declaration allowlisting, same-origin protection, and metadata-only output.

requirements.description: Subscription-backed inference must carry the consumer token to ai-gateway while local and BYOK paths remain unmetered.
requirements.title: Trusted Metered Inference Routing

validation.notes: AI provider package tests and monetization conformance cover the routed provider contract.

requirements.description: A fresh profile emits activation.first_command_run once after the first successful command execution.
requirements.title: First Command Activation

validation.notes: Durable activation event emission is covered by API tests; lifecycle/browser observation remains in Workflow Health evidence.

requirements.description: A fresh profile emits activation.first_ai_command_accepted once after the first successful AI command response.
requirements.title: First AI Command Activation

validation.notes: AI success invokes the durable activation emitter; lifecycle/browser observation remains in Workflow Health evidence.
